name: 90221 · Compton, CA
findings: ZIP 90221 (Compton) has 145 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90221 (Compton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90221 (Compton) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
